candidate.blueprint_locator: Appendix A, Management of Care > Performance Improvement (Quality Improvement), printed p.22 / PDF p.26
candidate.blueprint_topic: Management of Care — Performance Improvement (Quality Improvement)
candidate.educational_objective: Use outcome data to evaluate whether a performance-improvement intervention has affected client care.

options.A: Determine whether the intervention was implemented exactly as written without considering client outcomes
options.B: Evaluate the impact of the performance-improvement measure on client care outcomes
options.C: Establish the underlying cause of every individual fall from aggregate unit data alone
options.D: Determine whether staffing levels should be changed solely on the basis of the fall rate

candidate.rationale: The 2026 NCLEX-RN Test Plan places performance improvement within Management of Care and specifically includes evaluating the impact of performance-improvement measures on client care and resource use. Comparing outcome data before and after an intervention helps determine whether the improvement measure affected client care. A focuses only on implementation fidelity and ignores the stated outcome comparison. C overstates what aggregate data can establish about individual events. D makes a staffing decision from one outcome measure alone rather than evaluating the intervention's impact.
candidate.source_claim_supported: Entry-level RN Management of Care includes evaluating the impact of performance-improvement measures on client care and resource use.
candidate.source_locator: Appendix A, Management of Care > Performance Improvement (Quality Improvement), printed p.22 / PDF p.26: evaluate the impact of performance-improvement measures on client care and resource use
candidate.source_organization: National Council of State Boards of Nursing (NCSBN)
candidate.stem: A nursing unit implements a fall-prevention change as part of a performance-improvement project. The nurse compares fall data from before and after the change. What is the primary purpose of this comparison?
